q: What is CodeBite and what was the hardest part of building it?
answer: CodeBite is an algorithm practice platform built on deliberate practice, in Korean. It is inspired by Anders Ericsson's research: problems at the right level, immediate feedback, and spaced repetition. The hardest part of building it was submission-to-result latency was over 30 seconds. Four bottlenecks fixed: test cases sent to Judge0 one at a time (now batched, 13 at once), a new connection per call (now reused), the worker polled every 0.5 s (now 0.15 s), and the browser polled every 2 s (now server push). Result: Python 1.89 s, JavaScript 1.97 s, C++ 3.58 s, Java 8.34 s. Java stays higher because each test case compiles and starts a JVM, and that saturates the 4 CPU cores. I measured where code stops helping and hardware starts.

q: 제출 지연을 30초에서 1.9초로 줄였다는데 어떻게 한 거예요?
answer: 제출 지연을 30초에서 1.9초로 줄였는데, 주요한 방법은 테스트 케이스를 Judge0에 한 번씩 전송하여 batch 처리를 했고, 각 케이스에 새로운 연결을 보내는 것을 줄이기 위해 재사용을 했습니다. 또한, 작업자(worker)는 0.5초에서 0.15초로 줄이고, 브라우저는 2초에서 0.5초로 줄였습니다. 이로 인해 Python, JavaScript, C++ 및 Java의 제출-결과 지연 시간이 각각 1.89s, 1.97s, 3.58s, 8.34s로 줄어들었습니다.
